dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Hi Dias! Can you hear me?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Yes, I can hear you! Great connection today.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Perfect! So, how was your first week at WKU?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: It was amazing! I love the campus. The library is absolutely huge!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: I know! I went there on Monday. There are so many books. Did you meet any new people?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Yes! My roommate is from Kyzylorda. His name is Bekzat. He's very funny.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: That's great! My roommate is from Almaty. Her name is Zarina. She's a dancer!

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Wow, a dancer! How are your classes? Do you like them?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Yes! English class is my favourite. Ms. Aigerim is an excellent teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: She is! I also really like Computer Science. The teacher is young and very creative.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: What time do your classes start in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: At 8:30. It's early, but I don't mind. I'm a morning person!

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Same for me! Okay, I need to go now. It's dinner time in the dormitory.

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Okay! Talk soon. Good luck with your studies, Aizhan!
